traffic_forecast_notes: Observed hosted trial: peak 420 QPS (30-minute spike), 140 QPS sustained during business hours. Avg tokens per short-chat req = 58 tokens (input+output), long generation flows ~1,200 tokens avg (25% of traffic). Token mix: ~75% short interactive (60 tokens), 25% long (1200 tokens). Projected month-1 after rollout: 250 QPS sustained with 20% weekly growth; expected 95th percentile concurrency ~180. Monthly token volume estimate (month-1): ~1.9B tokens. Assumptions saved in drive POC spreadsheet.
poc_results_summary: Hosted API trial metrics: p50 latency for chat paths = 80ms, p95 = 210ms (meets target), p99 = 740ms (spikes on long generations). Error rate under trial = 0.3% (mostly rate-limit transient), cold KV misses increased cost by ~6%. Cost: Hosted run extrapolated to Dedicated-equivalent shows token spend ~USD 12k/month at current usage; team sensitive to 3x+ increases with growth. They tested fallback to smaller model for non-critical reranking; quality delta acceptable for 40% of rerank calls.
dedicated_capacity_sizing: SE recommendation: initial Dedicated pool = 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (or 8x A40-equivalent) with capacity headroom for 2x sustained and 3x burst. Concurrency target: reserve for 200 concurrent chat sessions with autoscale bursts to 350 for peak windows. KV cache nodes sized to hold hot prefixes (expected 120GB KV state). Recommended rollout: 6-month reserved commit for baseline throughput + burst credits; enable routing policy: low-cost model (quantized) for fallback and region failover. Pricing model to propose: committed monthly capacity + token overage to limit procurement risk.
